7. The quotation and invoice mentioned above are at Annexure 1. There is no separate written contract entered into between PC&E and China Status for this project.

8. China Status had previously been engaged by PC&E for 2 other building renovation projects. The buildings involved are Mayland Court at 1-7 Shelter Street, Causeway Bay, Hong Kong, and Chung Sing Building, at 63 Chung Wui Street, Tai Kok Tsui, Kowloon. Both of these projects involve China Status submitting SDNs to the FSD for their respective FH / HR Systems, while the Chung Sing Building project also involved work to comply with Fire Safety Improvement Directions issued by the FSD.

9. There are other projects in which China Status had been or are engaged by PC&E that do not relate to building renovation. Details relating to these projects can be provided if required.

Question 2

10. In relation to China Status’ services at Wang Fuk Court, I am the main contact person of China Status. The main contact persons of PC&E that I communicate with are Mr. Cheung and his superior Mr. Gordon Ho. I do not know the full name of Mr. Ho.

11. For the purposes of this project, I set up a WhatsApp group on 7th April 2025 comprising 3 individuals, namely Mr. Cheung of PC&E, Ms. Chung Man Wai Daisy of China Status (“Ms. Chung”), and myself. Ms. Chung is an accountant clerk of China Status, and she assisted me with paperwork and administrative matters in this project under my supervision.

12. All written communications between China Status and PC&E in relation to this project took place in this WhatsApp group. There were communications by telephone calls form at times, but in my knowledge there would no written correspondence between the 2 companies outside of this WhatsApp group. At Annexure 2 is a complete set of screenshots of all communications that have taken place in this WhatsApp group.
